lore: Blood-curdling wolf cries signal to opponents that Banehallow is among them.

name: Feral Impulse
desc: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.
lore: His animalistic symbiosis with canine kind gives Banehallow enhanced reflexes and hunting capabilities.

name: Shapeshift
desc: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
lore: Forever a slave to his lycanthropy, Banehallow has come to accept his curse, and embrace his own savagery.

name: Cripple
desc: Gives %maim_chance%% to cripple the target, causing %maim_damage% damage per second and lose %maim_attack_speed% Attack Speed for %maim_duration% seconds.

name: Invisibility
desc: Permanently invisible when not attacking.

name: Hamstring
desc: The wolf bites down on an enemy's hamstring, rooting them for a short duration. After the bite, the next %damage_boost_stacks% attacks from units controlled by Lycan deal bonus damage.

name: Hightail
desc: The wolf gains a short burst of energy, gaining phased movement, evasion, hasted movement speed, and attack speed.

name: Apex Predator
desc: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

name: Thunder Clap
desc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.
lore: A slam of Mangix' mighty keg starts the festivities.

name: Cinder Brew
desc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed.  If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by %extra_duration%s and causing them to take damage over time.
lore: The Order of the Oyo's solution to all problems - another round!

name: Drunken Brawler
desc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by %brewed_up_bonus%% for %brewed_up_duration%s.  If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by %brewed_up_duration_extend%s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
lore: When Mangix won his title as the Brewmaster of the Order of Oyo, he also claimed his place in the mastery of inebriation.

name: Drunken Brawler - Brew Up
desc: Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up and his stance becomes empowered.  If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended.  The cooldown starts when the effect ends.

name: Liquid Courage
desc: When Brewmaster drops below %min_health_threshold%% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every %speed_toggle_time%s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at %max_health_threshold%% Health.

name: Primal Split
desc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
lore: It isn't clear whether Mangix is consciously aware of his potent bond with nature, as it often occurs in the midst of a drunken stupor.

name: Primal Split Cancel
desc: Cancel the Primal Split.

name: Primal Companion
desc:
Creates a Brewling based on Brewmaster's current Drunken Brawler Stance.

A new Brewling cannot be resummoned for %cooldown_on_take_damage%s if the current one takes damage from enemy Heroes or hero-controlled units. If the Brewling dies, the ability goes on cooldown for %cooldown_on_death% seconds.

Only one Brewling can exist at a time. If Brewmaster uses Primal Split, the existing Brewling disappears.
lore: Mangix doesn't hold to it by rule, but he vaguely recalls an old master musing that, if one could manage, scaring up a companion was always preferable to drinking alone.

name: Hurl Boulder
desc: Throws a boulder at a unit, doing damage and stunning it.

name: Earth Element
desc: Magic, status, and slow resistance increased.

name: Demolish
desc: Deals bonus damage to buildings.

name: Dispel Magic
desc:
Damages summoned units in an area and dispels most buffs or debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

name: Cyclone
desc: Encloses a unit in a tornado, removing it from the battlefield and deals %landing_damage% damage when after they land.

name: Wind Walk
desc: Provides temporary invisibility.  Bonus movement speed and attack damage when invisible.

name: Permanent Immolation
desc: Burns nearby enemy units.

name: Permanent Phase
desc: Provides the Brewling with phased movement and bonus Status Resistance.

name: Disruption
desc: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.
lore: The pain of deception comes not while it happens, but when it is revealed.

name: Soul Catcher
desc:
Shadow Demon and his illusions' attacks reduce the current health of the target by %health_lost%% per stack.  When the effect expires, the target regains %health_regain_pct%% of the lost health.

If an enemy Hero dies under this effect, Shadow Demon creates an illusion of them that lasts until the Hero respawns or Shadow Demon dies.

name: Shadow Poison
desc: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to %max_multiply_stacks% stacks. Additional stacks cause %bonus_stack_damage% damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
lore: The ever growing influence of the Shadow Demon can pollute the most valiant and pure of heroes.

name: Shadow Poison Release
desc: Releases the poison to do damage on all affected enemies. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Shadow Poison.

name: Demonic Purge
desc:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: Once Shadow Demon no longer has any need for his collected cultist, he releases it from its subservience - and its life.

name: Demonic Cleanse
desc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration.  At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: The only one permitted to harm his more useful followers is Shadow Demon himself.

name: Disseminate
desc: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within %radius% range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
lore: Friends and families share in the suffering when Shadow Demon finds a new victim.

name: Menace
desc: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for %duration% seconds that increases their damage taken.

name: Gift Bearer
desc: Lone Druid's Spirit Bear receives a copy of his Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

name: Bear Necessities
desc: Lone Druid can only use the first %item_slots% items in his inventory. These items' passive bonuses are more powerful. Other item slots do not provide any bonuses. Neutral slot is unaffected.

name: Summon Spirit Bear
desc:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves %bear_attack_leash_range% distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers %backlash_damage%% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
lore: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.

name: Spirit Link
desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.

name: Spirit Link
desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.

name: Savage Roar
desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%.
lore: Sylla studies and masters the arts of the lost Bear Clan, enhancing his attunement with the wild.

name: Savage Roar
desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%.

name: True Form
desc: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
lore: The mighty bear is the king of the forest, possessing the throne through raw power.

name: Return
desc: Channels for %channel_tooltip% seconds and then teleports the Spirit Bear back to the Lone Druid.

name: Entangling Claws
desc:
Allows Spirit Bear to Entangle enemy heroes once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

Spirit Bear's attacks are permanently empowered, making them apply %spirit_bear_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

name: Entangle
desc:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.

name: Fetch
desc: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every %tick_rate%s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.

name: Demolish
desc: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.

name: Chaos Bolt
desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
lore: Even Chaos Knight cannot predict this manifest of unholy energy.

name: Reality Rift
desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
lore: Armageddon rides between the planes, bringing Chaos Knight to his victim wherever he may hide.

name: Chaos Strike
desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
lore: Chaos Knight's unwieldy power bludgeons those who stand before him, crushing the thickest of armors.

name: Phantasm
desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: Drawing on his battles fought across many worlds and many times, phantasms of the Chaos Knight rise up to quell all who oppose him.

name: Phantasmagoria
desc: All Chaos Knight Illusions are Strong Illusions and take less damage when near him.

name: Reins of Chaos
desc: Whenever illusions of Chaos Knight are created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%% chance that an additional %bonus_illusion_count% extra illusion will spawn.

name: Fundamental Forging
desc: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.

name: Earthbind
desc: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
lore: Catching dinner in the Riftshadow Ruins can be quite the task.

name: Poof
desc:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
lore: Sometimes breaking one of the Riftshadow Crystals can be just the trick for getting yourself out of a bind.  Or your other self.

name: Ransack
desc:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.
lore: So you gonna need that, or...?

name: Divided We Stand
desc:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.
lore: Do I know you?

name: MegaMeepo
desc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a %radius% radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains %stats_pct%% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals %poof_damage_factor%% more damage for each Meepo on top.
lore: Hi, Meepos!

name: MegaMeepo Fling
desc: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
lore: You go first!

name: Dig
desc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: I'm diggin' here!

name: Pack Rat
desc: All Meepos can use the item in the neutral item slot.

name: Sticky Fingers
desc: Has an extra choice of neutral item to select from.

name: Fling
desc:
Pick up the target friendly Meepo or creep, disarming yourself and disabling them.  Use the sub-ability to throw the carried unit at the target, dealing damage and slowing on impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier.  The carried target will be dropped after %hold_duration% seconds.
lore: You go first!

name: Geomancy
desc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain.  Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within %tree_radius% range, he receives %tree_regen% HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives %dirt_move_speed%% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by %water_move_slow%% for %water_slow_duration% seconds.

name: Nature's Guise
desc: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
lore: The Protectors don't often come into vision; their natural state being nestled within their leafy brethren.

name: Nature's Grasp
desc: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does %creep_penalty%% less damage to creeps.
lore: The tendrils of Rooftrellen's influence stretch to all corners of the forest.

name: Leech Seed
desc: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
lore: Rooftrellen nurtures the beings under his stewardship, sustained by the lifeforce of trespassers into his sacred ground.

name: Living Armor
desc: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
lore: The roots and tendrils of the Treant Protectors are far-reaching, stimulating the growth and rejuvenation of all of nature.

name: Overgrowth
desc: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
lore: Rooftrellen calls the ancestral spirit of nature, releasing its power through all of his kin.

name: Eyes In The Forest
desc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
lore: One can never be too certain who, or what, might need protecting.

name: Super Bloom
desc: Treant grows massive in size for %duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.

name: Dumb Luck
desc: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

name: Fireblast
desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
lore: The Ogre Magi is easily amused, entertained for hours by playing with fire.

name: Fire Shield
desc: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next %attacks% attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
lore: There is immense luck involved in Aggron not just setting friends on fire.

name: Unrefined Fireblast
desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing %base_damage% + %str_multiplier%x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is %scepter_mana%% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
lore: The 'who-casts-spell-first' argument between himself is solved simply by both casting at once.

name: Ignite
desc: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
lore: Batter up!

name: Bloodlust
desc: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
lore: 'Running's not as fun as hitting... Not one bit fun.'

name: Multicast
desc: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every %strength_for_one_pct% Strength adds %one_tooltip%%.
lore: Despite being largely incapacitated by his IQ, the Ogre Magi's success in battle is attributed to pure skill.

name: Ice Armor
desc: The Ogre Frostmage summons an invisible layer of icy air that surrounds the target friendly unit, increasing its armor and temporarily slowing any enemies that dare attack it.

name: Decay
desc: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
lore: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.

name: Soul Rip
desc: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
lore: Even allies feel despair in Undying's presence.

name: Tombstone
desc: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
lore: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.

name: Deathlust
desc: Slows enemy units on attack.  If the attacked unit's health goes below the threshold, the zombie receives enhanced movement and attack speed.

name: Flesh Golem
desc: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
lore: The flesh of the recently dead add to the power of Dirge's plague.

name: Ceaseless Dirge
desc: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.
lore: Only when the Dirge of the Dead God ceases will this soldier's march finally end.

name: Telekinesis
desc: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
lore: Even the Grandest Magus may use his powers for enjoyment.

name: Telekinesis Land
desc: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.

name: Telekinesis Land
desc: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

name: Fade Bolt
desc: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.
lore: Rubick's favorite spell for dispatching would-be assassins is a rather simple conjuration.

name: Arcane Supremacy
desc: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.
lore: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...

name: Might and Magus
desc: Rubick gains stacking bonus area of effect when he casts a spell.

name: Curiosity
desc:
Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus.

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds.  If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

name: Spell Steal
desc: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
lore: ...but even their lesser magics can be a source of much utility.

name: Stolen Spell
desc: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

name: Stolen Spell
desc: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

name: Thunder Strike
desc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
lore: Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.

name: Glimpse
desc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
lore: Playing with electricity can have unexpected results.

name: Kinetic Field
desc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
lore: The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.

name: Kinetic Fence
desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
lore: For a brief moment, it's as if the wind itself had turned solid.

name: Static Storm
desc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
lore: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.

name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
desc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
lore: Safe harbor found inside the storm.

name: Impale
desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
lore: All zealot scarabs possess intimate knowledge of underground pathways, using them to their advantage.

name: Mind Flare
desc: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
lore: Only those raised by the queen can use their minds to touch the world around them.

name: Spiked Carapace
desc:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
lore: While their carapace is relatively thin, it's guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.

name: Vendetta
desc: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%% faster attack animation for this attack.
lore: The scarab kills for the glory of his queen.

name: Burrow
desc: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
lore: Some castes of zealot scarab are known to create small burrows to lie in wait, ready to ambush their prey.

name: Unburrow
desc: Emerge from the burrow.
lore: Some castes of zealot scarab are known to create small burrows to lie in wait, ready to ambush their prey.

name: Nyxth Sense
desc: Nyx Assassin can detect heroes within %radius% units of himself.

name: Mana Burn
desc: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

name: Mirror Image
desc:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: Slithice, while being strong in her own right, is notoriously hard to track down.

name: Ensnare
desc: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
lore: The only way to escape the onslaught of a Slithereen is to never oppose one in the first place.

name: Rip Tide
desc: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
lore: A torrent from the Deep Ones crushes the defenses of the Siren's enemies.

name: Deluge
desc: Naga Siren and all of her images hit nearby units with a damaging wave of water that caps their max movement speed.
lore: There's no use trying to run through deep water.

name: Eelskin
desc: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within %radius% radius.

name: Song of the Siren
desc: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
lore: Slithice's powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.

name: Song of the Siren End
desc: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

name: Reel In
desc: CHANNELED - Naga Siren channels for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds, pulling all units affected by Naga's Ensnare in a %radius% range towards her at a speed of %pull_strength%. Channeling ends when the Ensnared unit is %min_pull_distance% distance away.
lore: Even the youngest Slithereen are well schooled in trawling for prey with nothing but their wits and nets.

name: Slithereen Cutlass
desc: Naga Siren's attacks add a stacking debuff that causes the target to miss attacks for %debuff_duration% seconds, up to a max of %max_stacks% stacks.

name: Illuminate
desc: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
lore: Ezalor's hidden light reveals itself in marvelous fashion.

name: Solar Bind
desc: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
lore: Even a glimpse of the First Light is enough to rob enemies of their senses.

name: Will-O-Wisp
desc: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
lore: Though he would not claim to 'know' them, Ezalor holds an uncanny influence over many powerful creatures always willing to come to his aid.

name: Chakra Magic
desc: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%% more effective when used on himself.
lore: In the same vein, Ezalor bestows his harmony among others.

name: Spirit Form
desc: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.
lore: In a flash of light, Ezalor reveals his true nature.

name: Recall
desc:
After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location.  If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.

 If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead.

 Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.
lore: Walk towards the light.

name: Blinding Light
desc: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
lore: The Primordial light turns the tides of battle in favor of Ezalor and his allies.

name: Release Illuminate
desc: Release the channel early.

name: Special Reserve
desc: Keeper of the Light cannot go below %minimum_mana% mana.

name: Bright Speed
desc:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.

name: Tether
desc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
lore: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.

name: Spirits
desc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
lore: Io twists the particles of the universe with its unimaginable capabilities.

name: Overcharge
desc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
lore: Drawing on the energy of matter from all worlds, Io begins the unravelling of time.

name: Relocate
desc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
lore: Io is the embodiment of the mystery of the universe.

name: Break Tether
desc: Break the link to the tethered unit.

name: Spirits In
desc: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

name: Spirits Out
desc: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

name: Wellspring
desc: Io regenerates from consumables and the fountain %consume_speed%x faster.

name: Equilibrium
desc: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

name: Grave Chill
desc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
lore: The warmth of the sun is never felt in the dark cold of the Narrow Maze.

name: Soul Assumption
desc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
lore: The collected souls of the dead reach out to bring another into their fold.

attrib.header: BONUS GOLD PER CHARGE PER KILL:

name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
desc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
lore: Visage's tough scales share equal properties of ghost and stone, making it nearly impervious to blade and magical assault.

name: Summon Familiars
desc:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
lore: Guardians of the Narrow Maze, Necro'lic's Familiars stand watch over his domain.

name: Silent as the Grave
desc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.
lore: Those on the mortal plane are blind to the stirrings of the agents of the afterlife.

name: Stone Form
desc:
Orders the Familiar closest to Visage to cast Stone Form in its current location, turning into stone and smashing into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area.  The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly.  After %stone_duration% seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

 Can be alt-cast to order the closest Familiar to the target location to move there and cast Stone Form.
lore: There is no weapon or spell devised that can mar the wroughtstone servants of death.

name: Stone Form
desc:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area.  The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly.  After %stone_duration% seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

 Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.

name: Lurker
desc:
Visage's ability cooldown durations are accelerated as long as he's not taking damage.

Grants a stack every %stack_gain_time%s that Visage does not take damage. Each stack grants %cooldown_speed_per_stack%% cooldown acceleration with a max of %max_stacks% stacks. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.

name: Recall Familiar
desc: Recall this familiar to Visage after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.

name: Depth Shroud
desc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
lore: Nothing worse than a job going bad thanks to some clompy-footed friend.

name: Dark Pact
desc:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
lore: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.

name: Pounce
desc: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.

name: Essence Shift
desc: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
lore: With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.

name: Shadow Dance
desc:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.  If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
lore: The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.

name: Saltwater Shiv
desc:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

name: Cold Blooded
desc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for %stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%s.
lore: Point your gaze at her if you dare.

name: Split Shot
desc:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
lore: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.

name: Mystic Snake
desc: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
lore: The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.

name: Mana Shield
desc: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%% less damage per point of mana.
lore: While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.

name: Stone Gaze
desc: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
lore: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.

name: Gorgon's Grasp
desc: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
lore: The best predators don't even need to pounce.

name: Undulation
desc: Medusa's movement speed is fixed at %fixed_movespeed% (%stone_gaze_ms_tooltip_only% during Stone Gaze). Medusa is unslowable and does not benefit from movement speed increases.

name: Berserker's Rage
desc:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.
lore: Like his anger, Troll Warlord's supply of axes is infinite.

name: Battle Stance
desc:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to %base_attack_time%.

Troll Warlord gains %armor_per_interval% armor per %attack_speed_interval% bonus attack speed.
lore: Jah'rakal has a variety of ways to get under an enemy's skin.

name: Whirling Axes (Ranged)
desc: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
lore: Only axes fueled by hate whirl with such a deadly spin.

name: Whirling Axes (Melee)
desc: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
lore: Keep your enemies close.

name: Fervor
desc: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
lore: If at first you don't succeed, strike, strike again.

name: Battle Trance
desc:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: An adrenaline rush of pure hatred quickens your blades.

name: Ensnare
desc: The Dark Troll Summoner tosses netting around an enemy's feet, briefly immobilizing the unit, though the unit can still attack and use abilities.

name: Raise Dead
desc: The Dark Troll Summoner stirs the ground underfoot, raising the remains of trolls long dead, bringing to life three skeleton Warriors who will fight at his side.

name: Hoof Stomp
desc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.
lore: When the mighty hoof of the Warrunner touches soil, the tremors are felt far and wide.

name: Double Edge
desc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
lore: In the spurs of combat, Bradwarden's vicious strikes sometimes cause self-inflicted collateral damage.

name: Retaliate
desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
lore: Bradwarden has no need to parry his opponent's attacks; his armor-like hide does it for him.

name: Stampede
desc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
lore: The great belt of Omexe, which labels Bradwarden as the greatest warrior of his kind, incites his fellow gladiators to follow him into barbarous combat.

name: Work Horse
desc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
lore: It is a great honor to be offered a ride by Centaur Warrunner and a grave mistake to refuse it.

name: Horsepower
desc:
Centaur Warrunner gains %strength_to_movement_pct%% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

name: Hitch A Ride
desc: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by %melee_attack_range%.
lore: The needs of Bradwarden's ample pride pale greatly in the face of his demand for victory.

name: Rawhide
desc: Permanently gain %health_per_upgrade% max health every %upgrade_rate%s.

name: Horn Toss
desc: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
lore: Survivors of Joerlak will never forget the sight of Magnus tossing countless enemies into rivers of fire and clouds of ash.

name: Shockwave
desc: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.
lore: Mt. Joerlak was a somewhat unstable mass, and Magnus has learned to channel its reverberations.

name: Empower
desc:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack.

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%% larger bonus.
lore: With a deep bellow, Magnus displays his true power.

name: Skewer
desc: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
lore: Magnoceros horns are valuable in direct proportion to their danger to prospective merchants.

name: Reverse Polarity
desc: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.
lore: Magnus fights with the fury of the erupting Mt. Joerlak.

name: Solid Core
desc: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

name: Flamethrower
desc: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.
lore: A single saw can only cut so much. A single spark can burn forever.

name: Whirling Death
desc: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
lore: In the case that Rizzrack gets surrounded by the vines and plants of his nightmares, he has an immediate chainsaw defense.

name: Timber Chain
desc: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it.  Any enemy in the path takes damage.
lore: You never know when you might need to escape from malevolent saplings.

name: Reactive Armor
desc: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as %stacks_per_hero_attack%x the amount.
lore: The saw-suit is equipped to react to the slightest touch with fortified defenses.

name: Chakram
desc: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
lore: The ultimate in anti-flora weaponry.

name: Return Chakram
desc: Returns the Chakram to Timbersaw.

name: Twisted Chakram
desc: Launches a second independent Chakram that follows a curved path and returns to Timbersaw, damaging and slowing enemies it passes through. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%% of health missing.
lore: A happy little accident in the lab turned wild new weapon in the forest.

name: Exposure Therapy
desc: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

name: Hairball
desc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
lore: Every part of Bristleback's body is a weapon -- even the parts he accidentally swallowed.

name: Viscous Nasal Goo
desc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
lore: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.

name: Quill Spray
desc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
lore: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.

name: Bristleback
desc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
lore: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.

name: Prickly
desc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

name: Brawler's Grit
desc: Every time Bristleback is Stunned, Hexed, Feared, Taunted, or Rooted he gains a stacking buff for %duration%s that provides status resistance and debuff amplificiation, up to a maximum of %max_stacks% stacks.

name: Warpath
desc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
lore: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided.  But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.

name: Ice Shards
desc: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for %shard_duration% seconds.
lore: In the frozen tundra near the Barrier, after the last sun of autumn has set, ice can form with alarming speed.

name: Snowball
desc: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a %snowball_grab_radius% radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
lore: Tales are still told of the wild feat that ended the grand brawl at White Fields.

name: Launch Snowball
desc: Launch the snowball toward the target.
lore: Into the great wide white!

name: Tag Team
desc: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts %debuff_duration% seconds.
lore: Even far from Cobalt, Tusk carries the 'Barrier Chill' in his very bones.

name: Drinking Buddies
desc: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
lore: The only thing better than finding a good drinking buddy is finding an equally good enemy the two of you can punch.

name: Bitter Chill
desc: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a %radius% unit radius.

name: Walrus PUNCH!
desc: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
lore: It never matters who throws the first punch, only who throws the last.

name: Walrus Kick
desc: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within %search_radius% radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by %creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%% if kicking a creep.
lore: Tusk may have made his name with his fists, but the wise enemy is wary of any and all limbs.

name: Arcane Bolt
desc: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
lore: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.

name: Concussive Shot
desc: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
lore: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.

name: Ancient Seal
desc: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
lore: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.

name: Mystic Flare
desc: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
lore: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.

name: Shield of the Scion
desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
lore: The court mages of Skywrath may only deploy their magic in defense of the kingdom and the throne.

name: Staff of the Scion
desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magic damage to an enemy hero with an ability, he reduces all his ability cooldowns by %cooldown_reduction%s.
lore: To raise the ire of Skywrath is to invite retribution that strikes like a storm.

name: Ruin and Restoration
desc: Skywrath Mage has %spell_lifesteal%% Spell Lifesteal.

name: Mist Coil
desc: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
lore: A mysterious vapor from the Font of Avernus now infuses the breath of Abaddon, who releases it at will.

name: Aphotic Shield
desc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
lore: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.

name: Withering Mist
desc: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for %duration%s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by %heal_reduction_pct%% if they are below %hp_threshold_pct%% HP.

name: Curse of Avernus
desc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by %tower_dps_pct%%.
lore: While the baptized draw strength from the Font, the gifts of Avernus are debilitating to the uninitiated.

name: Borrowed Time
desc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below %hp_threshold%.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
lore: The most unnatural of all the gifts of the Font of Avernus, this power defies mortal understanding.  What should hurt, instead heals; and what should kill gives strength anew.

name: Echo Stomp
desc: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
lore: The force of creation still echoes in the stomp of the Titan.

name: Echo Stomp
desc: Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.  Unconscious enemies will wake if they take damage.
lore: The force of creation still echoes in the stomp of the Titan.

name: Astral Spirit
desc:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
lore: Like the four fundamentals, Elder Titan exists across all planes at once and can draw other aspects of himself to assist in times of need.

name: Return Astral Spirit
desc: Returns the Astral Spirit to Elder Titan.

name: Move Astral Spirit
desc: Moves the Astral Spirit to target location.

name: Natural Order
desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
lore: As it was at the beginning, Elder Titan makes it so again.

name: Natural Order
desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
lore: As it was at the beginning, Elder Titan makes it so again.

name: Earth Splitter
desc: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
lore: That which he created, the titan tears asunder.

name: Momentum
desc: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.

name: Tip the Scales
desc: Allied creeps and buildings affected by Glyph of Fortification or Roshan's Banner deal %damage_bonus%% bonus damage.

name: Overwhelming Odds
desc: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a %movement_slow%% impact slow for %slow_duration%s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
lore: The archers of Stonehall are ready at Tresdin's command.

name: Press The Attack
desc:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
lore: The rallying horn of the Bronze Legion is able to inspire any heart.

name: Moment of Courage
desc: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
lore: Tresdin knows that an enemy's most vulnerable moment often follows their fiercest stroke.

name: Duel
desc: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
lore: To face a soldier of Stonehall in single combat is a challenge few can resist.

name: Outfight Them!
desc: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within %radius% range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for %duration%s; allies gain %ally_factor%% of the value.  This bonus stacks independently.

name: Searing Chains
desc: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
lore: Xin's harshest lessons often employed the use of red-hot chains.

name: Sleight of Fist
desc: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.
lore: The studied warrior must whip and weave through its enemies, burning each without pause.

name: Flame Guard
desc: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
lore: An enemy should never be allowed to approach without difficulty.

name: Immolation
desc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.

name: Fire Remnant
desc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at %speed_multiplier%% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
lore: By the spirit's power are Xin's teachings spread anew.

name: Activate Fire Remnant
desc: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.
lore: With blazing speed does a spirit fly!

name: Boulder Smash
desc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a %remnant_smash_radius_tooltip% radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.
lore: It is with the power of a mountain that Earth Spirit strikes his enemies.

name: Rolling Boulder
desc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a %delay%s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing %damage% + %damage_str%% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
lore: Calling upon his connection to the land, the Earth Spirit draws loose stone to him, which forms a protective ball that he can use to roll short distances.

name: Geomagnetic Grip
desc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
lore: Like calls to like. Even the minerals found in the blood and bones of living beings are not immune to the call of the Earth Spirit.

name: Stone Remnant
desc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location.  Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.  Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
lore: Earth Spirit calls forth a remnant of his stone army, long buried with him in the dark embrace of the Earth.

name: Enchant Remnant
desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies.

Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
lore: Kaolin uses the elemental power of the Earth to temporarily petrify living beings, so that they might be conscripted into his stone funerary army.

name: Magnetize
desc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.
lore: At the Earth Spirit's call, the minerals in the blood and bones of his enemies rebel against the bodies they find themselves in.

name: Reflection
desc: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
lore: In the fractal prison of Foulfell, Terrorblade learned the truth of this old tale: you are your own worst enemy.  Now it is a lesson he teaches others.

name: Conjure Image
desc: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
lore: There's only one thing more dangerous than facing Terrorblade.  Facing MORE Terrorblades!

name: Metamorphosis
desc: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within %metamorph_aura_tooltip% range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
lore: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control.  Meet Terrorblade's own worst self.

name: Terror Wave
desc: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
lore: A shockwave of power strong enough to break the walls of Foulfell itself.

name: Demon Zeal
desc: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
lore: Fear is fueled by confusion when Terrorblade's enemies see that the first cut he makes is one to embolden himself.

name: Sunder
desc: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
lore: You didn't need that life, did you?  The demon marauder steals that which you hold most dear.

attrib.header: IGNORE MINIMUM PCT FOR ENEMIES TOOLTIP:

name: Dark Unity
desc: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.

name: Icarus Dive
desc: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
lore: Though no stranger to travelling the cosmic void, soaring within an atmosphere offers unique pleasures.

name: Stop Icarus Dive
desc: Immediately cancels the dive.
lore: SCREE!

name: Fire Spirits
desc: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
lore: The ever-collapsing core of Phoenix often emits short-lived bursts of conscious light.

name: Sun Ray
desc: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
lore: The vent through which such stellar energy flows is mere atoms wide.

attrib.header: FOCAL POINT FULL LENGTH TOOLTIP ONLY:

name: Stop Sun Ray
desc: Immediately stops the Sun Ray.
lore: CHIRP!

name: Toggle Movement
desc: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
lore: SQAWRK!

name: Supernova
desc:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After %abilityduration% seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
lore: The solar crucible of a Supernova may be fatal, yet from its flames arise new beacons to wander infinity.

name: Launch Fire Spirit
desc: Each fire spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
lore: PKAWW! BOOM

name: Dying Light
desc: Phoenix deals %damage_pct%% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a %radius% radius every second.

name: Blinding Sun
desc: Phoenix ability debuffs apply a stackable %blind_per_second%% Miss chance per second. Lasts %blind_duration% seconds.

name: Fortune's End
desc:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: The astral orb crackles with power while raw energy lances out, temporarily disrupting an enemy's connection to their own body.

name: Fate's Edict
desc: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them %magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%% magic damage resistance.
lore: An unbreakable prophecy resounds: a chosen ally shall briefly suffer no magics.  Other kinds of suffering however...

name: Purifying Flames
desc: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
lore: Like a hall of mirrors might amplify the light of a single candle, the shattered walls of the universe can transform the light of prophecy into a burning torch.

name: False Promise
desc:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
lore: Foes and false prophets oft make lies of men's fates.

name: Rain of Destiny
desc: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.
lore: Through mixture of the astral and the atmospheric, Nerif bends a single reality into paradoxical alignment.

name: Diviner's Deck
desc:
Oracle pulls a random Tarot Card now and every %duration% seconds to receives its buff for %duration% seconds. Oracle always knows the next Tarot Card.

Death: %spell_amplification%% Spell Amplification
The Fool: %gold_bonus_pct%% Increased Gold Gain
The World: %int_bonus_pct%% Increased Intelligence
The Lovers: %heal_amplification%% Heal Amplification
The Tower: %barrier_amount% All Damage Barrier (regenerates after not taking damage for %barrier_restore_time%s)

name: Clairvoyant Curse
desc: Spell amplification increased by %spell_amplification%% per hero level.

name: Clairvoyant Cure
desc: Heal amplification increased by %heal_amplification%% per hero level.

name: Prognosticate
desc: Oracle will predict and announce to allies, where the next power rune will spawn (top or bottom) as well as Roshan's exact respawn time.

name: Proximity Mines
desc: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%% damage to buildings.
lore: The bane of Toterin!

name: Snare Trap
desc: Plant an invisible trap that, when triggered by a player-controlled target, does a small amount of damage over time and slows enemy cast speed. Affected units are also tethered inside of the trap radius. Snare Traps take %activation_time% seconds to activate and last for up to %duration% seconds.

name: Stasis Trap
desc: Plant an invisible trap that roots nearby enemy units instantly when triggered.
lore: The scourge of Trapper Town!

name: Blast Off!
desc: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
lore: Where we going?

name: Sticky Bomb
desc: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.
lore: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.

name: Reactive Tazer
desc:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
lore: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.

name: Detonate Tazer
desc: Detonate Reactive Tazer immediately.

name: Remote Mines
desc: Plant an invisible explosive that will only detonate after a brief delay when triggered.  Does not damage buildings.
lore: The downfall of Dredger's Bight!

name: Detonate M.A.D.
desc: Detonate your planted M.A.D.
lore: Why light one fuse when you can light them all?

name: PINPOINT DETONATE
desc: Detonate all selected remote mines.
lore: Kablooey!

name: Minefield Sign
desc:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal %bonus_mine_damage_pct%% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts %lifetime% seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within %trigger_radius% units of a minefield sign, the %aura_radius% units area around the sign will become a minefield for %minefield_duration% seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.
lore: Watch your step!

name: Squee's Scope
desc: Techies gains %attack_range_tooltip% attack range and attack projectile speed for each point of attack speed.

name: Spoon's Stash
desc: Techies stack all previously selected Enchantments onto newly crafted Neutral Items.

name: M.A.D.
desc:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after %explosion_delay%s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.

name: Arctic Burn
desc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%% of their current health each second.
lore: The same organ where some dragons stoke their inner flame is, in Auroth, a crucible of unimaginable cold. From deep within her frosty gullet, an exhalation sends enemies into burning agony.

name: Splinter Blast
desc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%.
lore: Produced slowly by specialized vesicles in her frozen gullet, Winter Wyvern blast shards of ice at her enemies.

name: Cold Embrace
desc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
lore: From winter's heart comes a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.

name: Winter's Curse
desc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
lore: The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.

name: Eldwurm Scholar
desc: When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within %xp_gain_range% of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to %mana_to_xp_percentage%% of the ultimate's manacost.

name: Eldwurm's Edda
desc: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by %tooltip_int_pct%% of its current value at the time of consumption.

name: Essence of the Blueheart
desc: Winter Wyvern's heals also restore mana.

name: Dragon Sight
desc: Winter Wyvern gains bonus damage when her attack range is over %attack_range_min%.

name: Eldwurm Studies
desc: Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

name: Flux
desc: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
lore: An infinitesimal fraction of the power which imprisoned the Ancients.

name: Magnetic Field
