desc: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
lore: Time and space are of little consequence to one as old as Zet.

attrib.header: RUNE PULL MAX SPEED AS MULTIPLIER OF PULL STRENGTH:

name: Spark Wraith
desc: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
lore: Lesser fragments of Zet's original self.

name: Tempest Double
desc:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
lore: Warped by the power of its peers, Arc Warden becomes what it despises most: disharmony.

name: Runic Infusion
desc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

name: Firestorm
desc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
lore: The flames of conquest blaze forth from the darkest depths of the abyss.

name: Pit of Malice
desc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every %pit_interval% seconds.
lore: Twisting into the seams of reality itself, Vrogros' manifest hatred paralyzes those who defy his will.

name: Atrophy Aura
desc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
lore: To merely stand in the presence of the Underlord is to feel the conviction of battle sapped from one's soul.

name: Fiend's Gate
desc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least %minimum_distance% away from each other.
lore: They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.

name: Invading Force
desc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive %dark_portal_multiplier%x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

name: Abyssal Horde
desc:
After teleporting through the Fiend's Gate, Underlord brings forth a Warrior or an Archer to aid him every %underling_spawn_interval%s that last for the duration of the Fiend's Gate.

The Warrior burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a passive movement speed aura.

name: Last Will
desc: Deals damage to the unit that kills the Necronomicon Warrior.

name: Mana Break
desc: Mana burned per hit, a portion of which is dealt as damage.

name: Archer Aura
desc: Increases movement of nearby units.

name: Boundless Strike
desc: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
lore: The legendary Jingu Bang grows to match its master's will, ensuring no enemy can escape the Monkey King's reach.

name: Mischief
desc: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.
lore: Watch out for that tree.

name: Revert Form
desc: Reverts Monkey King's shape to his original form.

name: Tree Dance
desc: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
lore: Sun Wukong dances nimbly along the treetop canopy, always just out of arm's reach.

name: Primal Spring
desc: CHANNELED - Monkey King springs out from his tree perch, damaging and slowing enemies in the area where he lands. Damage and slow amounts are in proportion to channel duration.
lore: Leaping from the safety of cover into the midst of his enemies, Sun Wukong attacks without mercy.

name: Wukong's Command
desc:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
lore: Monkey King rips out a tuft of fur to blow at his enemies, charging each strand to transform into a copy of himself.

name: Jingu Mastery
desc: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
lore: Always sensitive to the moods of its master, the Jingu Bang radiates power when Sun Wukong's combat fervor is on full display.

name: Changing of the Guard
desc: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a %transfiguration_duration%s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells

name: Swashbuckle
desc:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
lore: The Pangolier's blade is even nimbler than his tongue.

name: Shield Crash
desc:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
lore: Only in the midst of his enemies does the Pangolier truly thrive.

name: Lucky Shot
desc: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.
lore: The Pangolier's blade is guided more often by whim than reason.

name: Rolling Thunder
desc:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land.

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: Where his ancestors sought only refuge, the Pangolier saw opportunity...

name: Fortune Favors the Bold
desc: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.

name: Stop Rolling
desc: Halt!
lore: Donté Panlin stops when he pleases.

name: Roll Up
desc: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
lore: It requires deft tailwork and immense balance to defy momentum in the heart of battle.

name: End Roll Up
desc: Ends Pangolier's Roll Up early.

name: Bramble Maze
desc: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
lore: The fae realm exists all around you, merely waiting to draw you in...

name: Bedlam
desc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
lore: You'll have to excuse my friend Jex. He's really into murder.

name: Terrorize
desc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
lore: You think you know the first thing about fear? Jex'll show you what that word truly means...

name: Shadow Realm
desc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
lore: What you can't see will most definitely hurt you.

name: Cursed Crown
desc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
lore: Didn't anyone ever tell you? Never strike a deal with a fairy...

name: Pixie Dust
desc: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

attrib.header: HP REGEN AMP OUT OF WORLD:
MANA REGEN AMP OUT OF WORLD:

name: Stroke of Fate
desc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
lore: The corruptive force of Grimstroke's ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.

attrib.header: VECTOR ACCEPTABLE RADIAN TO SNAP VELOCITY:
VECTOR DISTANCE TO START FORCE TURNING:

name: Phantom's Embrace
desc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
lore: Grimstroke holds no sorrow for the downfall of his people. Only for Yaovhi, she who was most dear to him, does he feel even a semblance of longing.

name: Dark Portrait
desc: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
lore: No dark creation is beyond the skill of the master's hand.

name: Ink Swell
desc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
lore: Now that the rise of the ink tide no longer threatens to overwhelm Grimstroke, its tendrils of power are never far from his hand.

name: Ink Explosion
desc: Triggers an existing Ink Swell.

name: Soulbind
desc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
lore: The Ascended were chosen sons of Ashkavor, granted immense power by the bonds forged between their own souls and those they were charged with protecting. In the years that followed the ruination of his kin, Grimstroke discovered much more sinister applications for the binding rituals...

name: Ink Trail
desc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for %debuff_duration%s.

name: Spear of Mars
desc: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
lore: The legendary Spear of Mars still glows with the heat of the forge god's fires.

name: God's Rebuke
desc: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
lore: There isn't a warrior alive who can stand unmoved by the sting of Mars' rebuke.

name: Dauntless
desc: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in %radius% radius.

name: Immovable
desc: Mars cannot be affected by forced movement.

name: Bulwark
desc:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

 Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs %redirect_chance%% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
lore: Only the very foolish dare to fight fair with the god of war.

name: Arena Of Blood
desc: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
lore: The long-dead members of the Ash Legion, assembled from the finest warriors to ever test the might of Mars, still revel in the thrill of combat, gladly beholden to the hand that fell them for as long as he so commands.

name: Aether Remnant
desc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
lore: Inai exists far beyond the scope of a single point in space and time.

name: Dissimilate
desc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
lore: Inai much prefers to observe our plane free from the confines of corporeal form.

name: Astral Step
desc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
lore: A small step for Inai creates great devastation on the mortal plane.

name: Resonant Pulse
desc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
lore: Inai never hesitates to shroud himself in the essence of his true self when forced to interact with the mortal plane.

name: Symmetry
desc: Void Spirit gains a physical damage barrier when dealing magic damage to enemy heroes.

name: Intrinsic Edge
desc: Void Spirit gains %damage_stat_bonus_pct%% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and %secondary_stat_bonus_pct%% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

name: Scatterblast
desc: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by %point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
lore: A favorite from her collection, Beadie crafted Ol' Rackatee as her first line of defense when she ventured into the Outlands.

name: Mortimer Kisses
desc: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over %duration_tooltip% seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of %min_range%. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
lore: Little did Beadie know when she adopted Mortimer, dragon toads--which aren't even toads at all--share more than just a name with their distant draconic cousins.

name: Gobble Up
desc: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to %max_time_in_belly% seconds.
lore: SHLORP!

name: Spit Out
desc: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
lore: SPITTOOO!

name: Firesnap Cookie
desc: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
lore: With the help of a secret mixture that pairs Beadie's baking skills with her passion for black powder, these battle biscuits pack a punch.

name: Buckshot
desc: When attacking enemy heroes, Snapfire deals %damage_amp%% more damage with her auto attacks, but has a %miss_chance%% chance of a glancing shot, dealing %glancing_shot_damage_pct%% damage.

name: Lil' Shredder
desc: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire %buffed_attacks% attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
lore: Beadie constantly tinkers with a design she first dreamed up plotting an exodus from her old gang.

name: Boomstick
desc: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

name: Hunter's Boomerang
desc: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
lore: A precious last vestige of Hoodwink's childhood, converted into deadly distraction.

name: Decoy
desc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
lore: The best traps trigger whether you touch them or not.

name: Acorn Shot
desc:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
lore: Though she'll make do with almost anything, Oak and Ironwood acorns make the most effective projectiles -- and the bulk of Hoodwink's stash.

name: Bushwhack
desc: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
lore: Hoodwink favors Ironwood groves for ambushes, but the wary step carefully in all areas of the mistwoods.

name: Scurry
desc: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by %evasion_multiplier%.
lore: There's not a nook or cranny in the Wood Tomo'kan out of reach of Hoodwink's paws.

name: Sharpshooter
desc:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
lore: While her first arbalest was a chance discovery, Hoodwink now takes great care in carving and caring for her own -- of course with some necessary components pilfered or otherwise cleverly procured.

attrib.header: QUICK DRAW TOOLTIP PCT COOLDOWN REDUCTION:

name: End Sharpshooter
desc: Release the charged up shot, regain ability to move and attack.
lore: Fire!

name: Mistwoods Wayfarer
desc: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.

name: Tomo'kan Tracker
desc: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last %trail_history_duration% seconds in a %search_radius% area around her.

name: Starbreaker
desc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
lore: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.

name: Celestial Hammer
desc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
lore: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.

name: Converge
desc: Dawnbreaker recalls her hammer, pulling them together so they meet in the middle.

name: Luminosity
desc: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%% of the amount.
lore: Diminished in power without access to the Children's replenishing light, Valora can still recharge herself and her allies by creating order from the chaos which resides within each fight.

name: Solar Guardian
desc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
lore: Only in defense of an ally will Valora relent to call upon the last reserves of her old powers that still allow cosmic flight.

name: Break of Dawn
desc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.

name: Dispose
desc: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
lore: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.

name: Unleash
desc:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
lore: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.

name: Rebound
desc:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
lore: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.

name: Bodyguard
desc:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
lore: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.

name: Special Delivery
desc:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers %bonus_levels% bonus levels and %bonus_hp_tooltip% bonus health.
lore: Professional courtesy, from one courier to another.

name: Onslaught
desc:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him.

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
lore: The Beast's single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.

name: Begin Onslaught
desc: Begins the rush to the specified location.

name: Trample
desc: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every %step_distance% units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
lore: As the only member of his species to arrive on this world, locals can only speculate on the Beast's size relative to his kin. Such observation would prove easier of course if the subject didn't eat everything it sees and destroy most of what it doesn't.

name: Uproar
desc:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
lore: Already draped in a broken patchwork of barding and chains upon appearing in the mistwoods, the Beast tolerates no further attempts at subjugation.

name: Pulverize
desc: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.
lore: Though none are certain whether his utterances have true meaning, most concede the Beast's powerful grip and tendency to smash his enemies into naught but pulp and pieces communicates his intent well enough.

name: Rock Throw
desc:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
lore: AGAIN WITH THE ROCKS!

name: Colossal
desc: Primal Beast has %base_slow_resist%% base Slow Resistance and gains %aoe_per_threshold%% bonus Area of Effect and %slow_resistance_per_threshold%% Slow Resistance for every %hp_per_threshold% Max Health.

name: Dead Shot
desc:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
lore: A steady gunhand and an eternity of practice produce trickshots that defy the mortal mind.

name: The Calling
desc: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
lore: Muerta's family are forever beyond the spirit veil, but her deal with Death allows her to briefly call on them in times of want or need.

name: Gunslinger
desc: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
lore: Muerta offers all of her victims Mercy. Some are fortunate enough to also earn Grace.

attrib.header: DEAD SHOT COOLDOWN REDUCTION ON PROC:

name: Pierce the Veil
desc:
Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.

name: Ofrenda
desc:
Muerta places a sacred altar at the targeted location that increases her attack speed when she is near it.

When respawning, Muerta will gain the benefits of Pierce The Veil's corporeal form for %pierce_the_veil_duration_pct%% of the duration and respawn at the Ofrenda.

Muerta can select the Ofrenda and force it to destroy itself. Only one Ofrenda can exist at a time.

name: Supernatural
desc: Whenever an enemy hero dies within %stack_collection_range% units of Muerta, she gains a stack of %spell_amp_per_stack%% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.

name: Spectral Slug
desc: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.

name: Destroy Ofrenda
desc: Destroy this Ofrenda, ensuring that Muerta will respawn in the fountain.

name: Spotlight
desc: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
lore: Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distinction between infamy and fame.

name: Tame the Beasts
desc: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
lore: From unhappy crowds to unruly acts, nothing persuades a pack of animals quite like the crack of the Ringmaster's whip.

name: Crack
desc: *CRACK*

name: Escape Act
desc: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
lore: An adept assistant has nothing to fear within the confines of The Box. An amateur has...much darker prospects indeed.

name: Wheel of Wonder
desc:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.
lore: No, brave friends, illusions are for charlatans and card sharks. What you witness today is the power of true magic. But only if you dare set your gaze upon...the mesmerizing wheel.

name: Impalement Arts
desc: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
lore: Passed down through generations, it simply wouldn't be a Kettle Circus without the Great Cogliostro's signature trick.

name: Souvenir Slot
desc: Gather souvenirs from kills and assists.

name: Dark Carnival Barker
desc:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.

name: Funhouse Mirror
desc: Use: Proportion DistortionCreates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%% and takes  %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%% damage.

name: Whoopee Cushion
desc: Use: WhoopsiePropels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%.

name: Strongman Tonic
desc: Use: Forcefully ImbibeTemporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

name: Unicycle
desc: Use: Saddle UpSummons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

name: Weighted Pie
desc: Use: Toss PieKnocks enemies back, slows them by %max_slow_pct%% and reduces their vision to %vision_radius% recovering over %blind_duration% seconds, and prevents them from receiving vision from their allies for the duration. Instantly kills any non-ancient creep.

name: Crystal Ball
desc: Use: ClairvoyanceScans a targeted %radius% area with global range for %duration% seconds. Indicates whether there are enemy heroes in that area for the duration. Reveals invisible units and wards in the scanned area, but does not provide vision. The reveal effect lingers for %truesight_linger_duration% second.

name: Switch Discipline
desc:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
lore: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.

name: Echo Slash
desc: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
lore: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.

name: Grappling Claw
desc: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
lore: The Kazurai have the speed and reach to drag even the highest flyers from the skies.

name: Kazurai Katana
desc:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
lore: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.

name: Raptor Dance
desc:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
lore: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.

name: Falcon Rush
desc: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
lore: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.

name: Talon Toss
desc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
lore: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.

name: Shodo Sai
desc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
lore: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.

name: Cancel
desc: Stop blocking physical attacks.

name: Raven's Veil
desc: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
lore: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.

name: Amphibian Rhapsody
desc:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
lore: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.

attrib.header: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK:

name: Bullbelly Blitz
desc: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
lore: 'Hey, when a beach brawl breaks out, you gotta learn to throw your musical weight around or the party's over proper quick.'

name: Hotfeet Hustle
desc: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.
lore: 'It's like that old story about the scary swamp witch. You better watch just where you're jumping when you're trying to do it lickety-split.'

name: Island Elixir
desc: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
lore: 'If this song can heal an ageless isaloth, it can handle a few cuts and bruises on the lot of you.'

name: Frogstomp
desc: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
lore: Most Bard Monks spend decades mastering the musical arts, but even the top frog Largo has to admit that his young disciples have already grown shockingly good at counting a proper beat.

name: Croak of Genius
desc:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
lore: Largo loves to help his friends find glory through the power of music, never missing a chance at a killer duet.

name: Catchy Lick
desc:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lore: After generations spent living on the ancient isaloth Velu'Mar, the descendants of the Murkroot exiles have grown resilient, happily sampling toxins that would've struck their ancestors dead.

name: Encore
desc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
